proof:
Source: Step 1 of the parent proof (invariance of the local Hoelder class under the affine isometry A(z) = xi + Q^{-1} z). All lemmas used are reachable from the frozen imports of GMT.Ch05.Submission.

Notation: T(y) := Q(y - xi) and A(z) := xi + Q^{-1} z. D^j denotes iteratedFDeriv R j (the global iterated Frechet derivative, as in IsLocallyHolderCkα).
1. T and A are mutually inverse: A(T y) = xi + Q^{-1} Q (y - xi) = y and T(A z) = Q(Q^{-1} z) = z. Both are isometries: |T y - T y'| = |Q(y - y')| = |y - y'| and |A z - A z'| = |Q^{-1}(z - z')| = |z - z'|. Both are continuous (a constant plus a continuous linear map, composed with a translation).
2. O is open. Since T and A are inverse bijections, O = T(U) = A^{-1}(U) (Set.image_eq_preimage_of_inverse). A is continuous and U is open, so A^{-1}(U) is open (IsOpen.preimage).
3. F is C^q on O. By hypothesis h is C^q on U. A is C^infinity (constant plus continuous linear map) and maps O into U (A(T y) = y in U for y in U), so h o A is C^q on O (ContDiffOn.comp). Q is a continuous linear map, hence C^infinity, so F = Q o (h o A) is C^q on O (ContDiff.comp_contDiffOn).
4. Formula for D^q F at an arbitrary point z (no smoothness is needed for these identities). Write h o A = (h o tau) o Q^{-1} with tau(w) := xi + w. (a) D^q (h o tau)(w) = D^q h(xi + w) (iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left). (b) D^q ((h o tau) o Q^{-1})(z) = (D^q (h o tau)(Q^{-1} z)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Q^{-1}) (ContinuousLinearEquiv.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right for the linear equivalence Q^{-1} and the set univ, together with iteratedFDerivWithin_univ). (c) D^q (Q o (h o A))(z) = Q.compContinuousMultilinearMap (D^q (h o A)(z)) (ContinuousLinearEquiv.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left). Hence D^q F(z) = Phi(D^q h(A z)) where, for a continuous q-multilinear map M, Phi(M) := Q o M o (Q^{-1}, ..., Q^{-1}) (that is, Q.compContinuousMultilinearMap (M.compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Q^{-1}))). Phi is additive in M: evaluating both sides at an arbitrary tuple of vectors and using that Q is additive gives Phi(M) - Phi(M') = Phi(M - M') (extensionality for continuous multilinear maps). Hence D^q F(z) - D^q F(w) = Phi(D^q h(A z) - D^q h(A w)) for all z, w.
5. Phi preserves norms: |Q o M'| = |M'| because Q is a linear isometry (LinearIsometry.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap), and |M o (Q^{-1}, ..., Q^{-1})| = |M| because every Q^{-1} is a linear isometry equivalence (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuous_linearIsometryEquiv). Therefore |D^q F(z) - D^q F(w)| = |D^q h(A z) - D^q h(A w)| for all z, w.
6. Hoelder bound on compact sets. Let K be a compact subset of O. A(K) is compact (continuous image) and A(K) is contained in A(O) = U (A(T y) = y). By the second part of the hypothesis there is C with |D^q h(a) - D^q h(b)| <= C |a - b|^alpha for all a, b in A(K). For z, w in K, step 5 and |A z - A w| = |z - w| give |D^q F(z) - D^q F(w)| = |D^q h(A z) - D^q h(A w)| <= C |A z - A w|^alpha = C |z - w|^alpha.
7. Steps 3 and 6 are the two parts of IsLocallyHolderCkα q alpha F O, and step 2 is the openness of O.
